scenes.head: 吃得均衡，其實很簡單
scenes.say: 吃得均衡很簡單。國民健康署的「我的餐盤」，用六句口訣幫你記住。
scenes.veo: Top-down shot of a round plate divided into sections with rice, vegetables, fruit, tofu and fish, bright natural light.

scenes.head: 每天早晚一杯奶
scenes.say: 第一句，每天早晚一杯奶。每天一杯半到兩杯乳品，一杯約兩百四十毫升。
scenes.veo: A glass of milk being poured on a breakfast table in soft morning light, slow motion.

scenes.head: 每餐水果拳頭大
scenes.say: 第二句，每餐水果拳頭大，選擇當季、多樣化。
scenes.veo: A hand holding a fresh guava next to a fist-sized portion of cut fruit in a small bowl, colorful and fresh.

scenes.head: 菜比水果多一點
scenes.say: 第三句，菜比水果多一點，深色蔬菜最好佔三分之一以上。
scenes.veo: Close-up of stir-fried leafy greens and broccoli in a bowl, vibrant green, steam rising.

scenes.head: 飯跟蔬菜一樣多
scenes.say: 第四句，飯跟蔬菜一樣多，其中三分之一以上，選擇糙米、燕麥等未精製全穀。
scenes.veo: Side-by-side bowls of brown rice and mixed vegetables of equal size on a table, gentle camera slide.

scenes.head: 豆魚蛋肉一掌心
scenes.say: 第五句，豆魚蛋肉一掌心。優先選豆類，其次是魚和海鮮，再來是蛋，最後才是肉類。
scenes.veo: An open palm next to a palm-sized piece of grilled fish and a block of tofu on a plate, clean composition.

scenes.head: 堅果種子一茶匙
scenes.say: 第六句，堅果種子一茶匙。一天約一份，例如五粒杏仁果。
scenes.veo: Macro shot of a teaspoon of mixed nuts and seeds being sprinkled over a salad.

scenes.head: 選餐小技巧
scenes.say: 選餐時多一份蔬菜、少一點含糖飲料，就是好的開始。
scenes.veo: A person at a food counter choosing an extra vegetable side dish and a bottle of water instead of soda.

scenes.head: 資料來源
scenes.say: 資料來源：國民健康署。有特殊健康需求，請諮詢營養師或醫師。
scenes.veo: Friendly dietitian in a white coat explaining a healthy plate model to a visitor in a bright clinic room.

scenes.head: 品富餐飲
scenes.say: 品富餐飲，陪你均衡吃，每一餐都有好心情。
scenes.veo: Group of coworkers sharing a balanced lunch together and laughing in a sunny break room.
